notes.title: New Lovish Trailer Revealed at The MIX Fall Showcase 2024!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Check out the [b]brand-new trailer[/b] for Lovish we debuted at The MIX Fall Showcase 2024! 

[previewyoutube=3r2E5EIY7XY;full][/previewyoutube]
The new trailer introduces the story of Sir Solomon and his hilarious quest for love. It shows the pivotal moment when Solomon abandons his friends to embark on a solo mission into the Devil Lord's castle, setting the stage for an 8-bit action-adventure filled with twists, absurdities, and unpredictable outcomes! You can also get an exciting new glimpse at the action stages and the laugh-out-loud post-stage sequences that make Lovish a truly one-of-a-kind experience.

Lovish is a must-play title for fans of classic 2D pixel art action games. A prologue demo is currently available on Steam so check it out if you haven't yet! Please wishlist the game to stay updated on its journey to release in 2025!

notes.title: Lovish Official Announcement!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! I’m Matt Kap! Some of you may know me from my work on [i]Castle In The Darkness[/i], [i]Astalon: Tears of the Earth[/i], and [i]The Binding Of Isaac: Rebirth[/i].

I’d like to introduce LABS next game, [b]LOVISH[/b]! What started off as a side-project that I was messing around with in between [i]Castle In The Darkness 2[/i] tasks (that’s still going smoothly by the way) has become a full and proper game! 
[b]
LOVISH[/b] is an action-adventure platformer that’s full of heart (get it?)! Play as Sir Solomon, as he quests through 50+ bite-sized stages in order to “rescue” the “love of his life”, Princess Tsuna, from the grasp of the evil Devil Lord! Between every stage, you will see a random event scene, in which anything could happen! Honestly, the less said the better, there are a lot of surprises. Find items, defeat monsters, see familiar faces, and collect crowns on your way to your showdown with Devil Lord! 

Working on [b]LOVISH[/b] has been the most fun I’ve had working on a videogame project, and I think that fun and light-heartedness shows through in the game itself. Available now, as part of Steam Next Fest, is a short and independent prologue demo that tells a little bit of the story up until the events of the main game.

I’d love to hear what you think, so please try it out and wishlist it :).
Next time I’ll talk a bit about the team behind [b]LOVISH[/b]! See you!
